deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'that is', stating that acetylation or deacetylation is the state of transcription within the cell itself, whereas the original text does not equate the two.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: to the acetylation or deacetylation, the state of the transcription within the cell itself.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and to acetylation or deacetylation, that is, the state of transcription within the cell itself.
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The addition of 'that is' creates an unsourced link asserting that two distinct things are the same.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The speaker appeared to use 'the state of the transcription' in apposition to explain the consequence of acetylation or deacetylation, which 'that is' renders naturally.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite attributes predisposing to chronic inflammatory events to 'infection' generally, whereas the text attributes this to 'they' (the roughly seven human viruses).
deficiencies.sourcePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that will precipitate cancer, and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events that can also help to give rise to cancer.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that precipitate cancer, and infection can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events, which can also help to give rise to cancer.
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: Replacing the specific viral agents with 'infection' broadens the stated cause, which violates the prohibition against changed causes.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The sentence sits in a paragraph introduced by 'infection', making 'infection' a natural stylistic substitute for the pronoun 'they'.

considerations.sourcePassage: So I've just made this kind of a much simpler diagram, if you like.
considerations.reason: The rewrite adapts the lecturer's remark about presenting a simpler diagram into a descriptive sentence accompanied by a [FIGURE] marker, which is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur, and as I said, we don't know pretty much because of this when they occur.
considerations.reason: The rewrite rephrases 'we don't know pretty much because of this' as 'because of this it is largely not known', which is a permissible stylistic reformulation preserving the original meaning.
